cell_line.evidence: keywords: Translocase of the outer mitochondrial membrane; Ap-ms; Mitochondria; Protein import; Quantitative mass spectrometry; Hek293t cells

SILAC labeling of cells: HEK293 Flp-In T-Rex control cells and cells expressing FLAG-tagged TRABD were cultured in SILAC-DMEM high glucose medium (AC-LM-0065, Anprotec) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, 1 mM sodium pyruvate and 50 µg/ml uridine and either heavy or light amino acids of L-arginine (100 mg/l) and L-lysine (140 mg/l).

Proteins affinity-purified from mitochondrial fractions generated from differentially “heavy” (Arg10/Lys8) or “light” (Arg0/Lys0) SILAC labeled HEK293 wildtype cells (control) or from cells that expressed the FLAG-tagged TRABD were combined, separated by SDS-PAGE and processed for LC-MS analysis including reduction and alkylation of cysteine residues and tryptic in-gel digestion as described before (Dewar et al. 2022, J Biol Cell 298; Peikert et al. 2017, Nat Commun 8).
